facts.fact: POTRAZ's Q4 2025 sector report (Table 20) gives Zimbabwe's national fibre backbone as 14,357 km in total across six operators: Liquid Intelligent Technologies 4,631.4 km, TelOne 4,046 km, Powertel 3,869 km, African Fibre Networks 985 km, Dandemutande 560 km and Africom 266 km; it names no regions or towns served.
